title: Vintage Flower Pattern Mug Set of 4, 12oz - No Box, Used
descriptionText: Vintage Mug Set of 4 in a Flower pattern, each mug holding 12oz. The set is in a vibrant Red color with a seasonal and floral theme, making it perfect for Summer, Spring, or any occasion. This vintage set includes 4 coffee mugs and is ideal for serving hot beverages.
